commitResults.messageTitle: Put the settings back when the data cannot be saved
commitResults.messageBody:
When the data file cannot be saved, LogicManager puts the data back as
it was and says that nothing was changed, so that the command can be
run again. But it does not put the settings back, so after set the
setting stays changed, and closing the app saves it.

Let's put back the settings as well, as restore does for the data.

Fixes #261

commitResults.messageTitle: Warn that deleting a patient deletes appointments
commitResults.messageBody:
The UG tells users to correct a wrong ID by deleting the patient and
adding them again, but doing so also deletes the patient's
appointments, and neither the UG nor delete says so.

Let's warn about this in edit, with how to keep the appointments, and
say it in delete as well.

Fixes #262

commitResults.messageBody:

double-clicking the JAR, write-protected folders, and secondary windows

who hits one has nothing to go by.

Let's add a short note on each, after the step that runs the JAR, and
remove the trailing space on DG line 25, which CI warns about.

Fixes #263

commitResults.messageTitle: Style callout badges inside bold matches
commitResults.messageBody:
The command-format info note wraps its icon in bold markers, so the

styling never runs: the note rendered as plain white bold text.

Key changes:

  bold, instead of dropping the styling.
- Pin both bold-wrapped callout forms with regression tests.

commitResults.messageBody:
The quick start's "_home folder_" italic rendered with literal

so the guide's italics render as italics, and pin it with a test.

Key changes:
- Match _text_ in the inline pattern and render it italic.
- Test that the home-folder italics render without underscores.

commitResults.messageTitle: Keep the backup when the data file is missing
commitResults.messageBody:
When lainurse.json is missing, LaiNurse loads the sample data with no
message, and the next command that succeeds, even view, replaces the
backup with that sample data. The user's data is then gone from both
files.

Deleting the data file must stay the way to start again from the sample
data, so let's keep loading it, but first copy any backup to
lainurse.previous.json, and tell the user how to restore it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Use confirm as the confirmation phrase
commitResults.messageBody:
clear and clearappt ask the user to type I LOVE 2103T. This is an
in-joke that means nothing to a nurse, and it is slow to type.

Let's use the word confirm instead. It is still a separate word that
the user must type, so pressing Up and Enter cannot confirm by reflex.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Explain the confirmation in the clearappt section
commitResults.messageBody:
The clearappt section says only that the user confirms the deletion
first. What that means is explained under clear, which comes later in
the User Guide.

Let's say what happens and link to the caution under clear.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Document that add and edit store quotes
commitResults.messageBody:
find removes quotes around a value, but add and edit store them as part
of the value, and the User Guide does not say so. A user who has learned
quoting from find gets stray quotes in patient records.

Let's say so in both sections, and tell users to leave them out.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Reject a null entry in the patients list
commitResults.messageBody:
A null entry in the patients list of the data file crashes LaiNurse at
startup with a NullPointerException, so the window never opens. Every
other invalid data file is handled.

Let's treat it as an invalid file too, so that LaiNurse keeps a copy of
it and loads the backup, as it does for any other invalid file.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Ask for confirmation before delete
commitResults.messageBody:
delete removes a patient and all their appointments at once, and it
cannot be undone. The backup receives the deletion at the same save, so
it cannot restore them either. clear and clearappt ask first, but delete
does not.

Let's make DeleteCommand a Confirmable, so that it says what it would
delete and waits for the confirmation word.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Say that a plain viewappt shows this week
commitResults.messageBody:
A plain viewappt shows the weekly view of this week, but says that it
listed all appointments. The messages for --all and --archived say the
same.

Let's change the three messages to say what the command shows.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Use --date for the new date in editappt
commitResults.messageBody:
addappt takes an appointment's date with --date, but editappt takes the
new date with --to, which is the end of a range in viewappt and
clearappt. So the same option means two different things.

Let's use --date in editappt too. viewappt and clearappt keep --to, and
editappt --to is now rejected as an unknown option.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Remove the list command word
commitResults.messageBody:
list does the same as a plain view, but the User Guide never mentions
it, and it ignores --all and --archived while still saying what it
listed. Keeping two names for one command only adds to what users must
learn.

Let's remove the word, and use view in the docs and tests. ListCommand
stays, because a view without an ID runs it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Add changing numbers to the Known issues

Adding, moving or deleting an appointment can change the numbers of

Let's add an entry that says to check the number first.

commitResults.messageBody:
Patient details are saved in plain text with no password or encryption,

Let's say so in Saving the data.

Some examples and notes repeat what the guide says elsewhere, the ...

commitResults.messageTitle: Make the Developer Guide format uniform
commitResults.messageBody:
Different sections use different formats for design choices, use case
endings and steps, and manual tests, and the help section has its own
heading levels. Some terms are also spelled in two ways.

Let's use one format for each, and one spelling for each term. The
choices in Editing a patient's details now also state the other option.

The setting names are long to type, and they use different forms, such

settings keep their values, as the preferences file does not store

commitResults.messageTitle: Load default preferences when a value is null
commitResults.messageBody:
"settings": null or "guiSettings": null in preferences.json crashes
LaiNurse at startup, and so does a file that contains only null.
Jackson stores the null, and copying the preferences later rejects it.
A value of the wrong type, by contrast, makes the file fail to load, and
LaiNurse uses the default preferences.

Let's copy the preferences as they load, so that a null fails to load in
the same way. UserPrefs keeps rejecting null from other callers.

Part of #267 (item 2)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Report an appointment number too large as typed
commitResults.messageBody:
A number too large for a long is read as Long.MAX_VALUE, so the error
names #9223372036854775807, which is not what the user typed.

Let's reject such a number when parsing, with an error that repeats it.
Carrying the digits to the command instead would need a new number type
in every appointment command, which is too much for a number that no
appointment can have. Smaller numbers still report that the patient has
no such appointment.

Part of #267 (item 8)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Treat a data file with only null as unreadable
commitResults.messageBody:
A lainurse.json that contains only null crashes LaiNurse at startup, as
readJsonFile passes the null result to Optional.of. Any other unreadable
file is handled: LaiNurse copies it to lainurse.corrupt.json, and loads
the backup or starts with no data.

Let's make such a file fail to load in the same way.

#267 does not list this crash. It came up while testing item 2.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Complete the clash and empty-list docs
commitResults.messageBody:
The DG says that done visits never clash, but settings can change that.
The UG gives only two of the four messages that an empty patient list
can show.

Let's say that the clash rule holds under the default settings, and list
all four messages.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Stop the weeks at the years 0000 and 9999
commitResults.messageBody:
Dates have a four-digit, unsigned year, but the weekly view can go
beyond them. Left and Right reach weeks such as "Mon 3 - Sun 9 Jan
+10000", and an appointment on 0000-01-01 opens a week that starts in
the year -0001.

Let's stop at the first and last weeks, and leave out their days that a
date cannot have. Left and Right there change nothing, and keep the
selection, as there is no other week to show.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Move by a screen with Page Up and Page Down
commitResults.messageBody:
In the appointment list, Page Up and Page Down jump to the first and
last appointment of the page, as Home and End do. In the patient list,
they move about one screen. On a long page, the appointment list has no
key to move further than one appointment at a time, short of its ends.

Let's move by the rows shown, less one, and land on the nearest
appointment, so that a day heading is still never selected.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Always show the details scroll bar
commitResults.messageBody:
While the window is resized, the details panel can flicker. Its scroll
bar shows only when needed, and takes width from the text. So the text
can wrap more with the bar, and overflow, and fit without it. At some
sizes, the bar then flips on and off in every frame.

Let's always show the bar, so that the width of the text no longer
depends on it. The bar's track stays in view when the details fit,
which is a small price for a panel that holds still.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Add more questions to the FAQ
commitResults.messageBody:
The FAQ has one question, about moving data. Readers will also want to
know where their data is, whether a deletion can be undone, why their
text is in capitals and whether appointments can overlap, and the
answers are spread across the guide.

Let's answer these four in the FAQ, and link to the details.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Complete setting names with Tab after set
commitResults.messageBody:
Tab completes command words, options, IDs and help topics, but nothing
after set, although the setting names are long and easy to mistype.

Let's complete the setting name, then on or off.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Use the right singular or plural in messages
commitResults.messageBody:
Messages say "1 patient(s)" and "2 appointment(s)", which reads as
unfinished in a product that a nurse uses all day.

Let's add Messages#formatCount, and use it in each message with a count.
The log messages keep their wording, as users do not see them.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Scroll the result display from the command box
commitResults.messageBody:
The result display is short, so a long message needs scrolling, but the
keyboard cannot reach it, as it never takes the focus. Shift+Up and
Shift+Down scroll the details from a list, and do nothing in the command
box.

Let's make them scroll the result display from the command box, so that
a long message can be read without leaving it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Accept the clearappt ID only as a plain word
commitResults.messageBody:
clearappt accepts a patient ID in two forms, clearappt ID and clearappt
--id ID, while every other command that needs an existing patient takes
it first, except viewappt. Two forms are more to learn and document, and
one of them does not match the rest.

Let's keep only the ID as the first word. clearappt --id now gets the
command format error.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: List known limits and planned features in guides
commitResults.messageBody:
Some limits of this version are not listed as known issues, and the
guides do not say which features are planned, so a reader cannot tell a
limit from a mistake.

Let's add four known issues to the UG, a Coming soon section for the
planned features, and proposed approaches for four of them to the DG.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge pull request #298 from dardenren/v1.6-doc-fixes
commitResults.messageBody: Fix three doc bugs found before the v1.6 release

commitResults.messageTitle: List all past appointments in the details
commitResults.messageBody:
The details list every upcoming appointment, but only the last ten past

commitResults.messageTitle: Warn about shared names when adding or editing
commitResults.messageBody:
Patient records are identified by ID, so add and edit allow patients
to share a name without notifying the user.

Nurses can overlook existing records or confuse patients who share a
name when no feedback highlights the overlap.

Append a non-blocking warning after successful additions and edits
whenever the resulting name matches another patient's normalized name.
Include archived and filtered-out patients, and warn even when an
edit leaves the name unchanged. Exclude the patient being changed.
List matching patients in name and ID order, marking archived matches.

Reuse existing name comparison and result feedback to keep matching
consistent and preserve saving and navigation behavior. Allow shared
names because different patients can legitimately have identical names.
Retain duplicate-ID rejection.

Add null checks, assertions, diagnostic logging and regression tests.
Cover normalization, self-exclusion, ordering, archived and hidden
patients, unchanged names, persistence and simultaneous backup warnings.
Update the User Guide and Developer Guide, including manual test cases.

Validation: all 1,012 tests, both Checkstyle checks and git diff --check
pass.

commitResults.messageTitle: Remove model details
Ignore punctuation in phone searches
commitResults.messageBody:
Phone searches compare literal text, so find --phone 987654 misses
a stored number such as +65 9876-5432.

Users should be able to find phone numbers without remembering their
stored formatting.

Compare only ASCII digits in phone criteria and stored numbers.
Preserve partial searches, leading zeros and existing result ranking.
Reject phone criteria containing no digits, including when other
search fields are supplied.

Keep normalization within searching to preserve stored numbers,
display formatting and add/edit validation. Reject digit-free criteria
to prevent an empty substring from matching every phone number.

Add validation exceptions, a normalization assertion and FINE logging
without recording search values. Add regression tests for formatting
differences, equivalent criteria, ranking and preservation of records,
filters and scope after invalid input. Update command help and both
the User Guide and Developer Guide.

Validation:
- Pass all 1,004 tests and Checkstyle with ./gradlew --offline check.
- Pass git diff --check.
- Limit src/main changes to 29 added and deleted lines, including
  comments and blank lines.
